rows.response_text:
To set up an email account on Verizon using Microsoft Outlook, follow these steps:

1. Open Microsoft Outlook and go to the "Change/View" menu.
2. Double-click on the email account you want to configure to access the settings screen.
3. Check the "My Server Requires Authentication" box.
4. Click through the Settings pop-up box into the "Log On Using" field and enter your Verizon email account name and password, as prompted.
5. Click on the "OK" button.
6. To set up the auto account setup process, open the "Add New Account" dialog box.
7. Configure the following settings in the "Email Account" section under "Auto Account Setup":
a. Type your full name in the "Your Name" box.
b. Type your e-mail address in the "Email Address" box.
c. Type the password that your ISP provided in the "Password" box.
d. Retype the password in the "Retype Password" box.
8. Click "Next" to begin the auto account setup process.
9. Outlook will then try to automatically configure your account.

Note: If your ISP requires the full email address to be entered into the "User Name" field, make sure to do so before proceeding with the auto account setup process.
